title: Reconcile qa/legacy and ux-patterns-quick-reference tutor-mode docs with the grant-based tutoring redesign

evidence.quote: all 5 routes, `TutorPinGuard` active, 7 screens ... deprioritized ... no new investment
TUTOR-10 | P0 | Cannot mark completions in tutor mode
TRACK-10 | P1 | Activate tutor track prompts PIN setup
Tutor mode is read-only (FR100) while parent mode has full write access.
linked to `ux-design-specification.md` which has been archived under [`docs/_archive/superseded/`]
Check [UX Design Specification](ux-design-specification.md) for full rationale and mockups.

why: grep confirms TutorPinGuard no longer exists anywhere in lib/ — superseded by an invite/accept/revoke M:N grant model under lib/features/tutoring/ (tutor_grant.dart, tutor_pin_entry_gate.dart, invite_tutor_screen.dart, manage_tutors_screen.dart). The 'deprioritized, no new investment' claim in 11-tutor-mode.md's own callout is itself now contradicted by this same repo's later planning docs (tutor-mode-brief.md 2026-05-20, tutor-talmid-view-plan 2026-05-26, tutor-edit-propagation-plan 2026-05-28), whose trackers record a completed multi-week rebuild that also gave tutors Manage-Tracks and Bulk-prior write access beyond 'strictly read-only.' A tester using these docs looks for a self-service Settings PIN flow that no longer exists, and would flag the now-intentional edit capability as a regression against a stale spec.
recommendation: Mark 11-tutor-mode.md and the tutor cross-references in 05-multi-track.md/10-parent-mode.md as superseded by the grant-based model (or move 11-tutor-mode.md fully under docs/_archive, matching the existing Epic-11 archive entry), and correct the ux-patterns-quick-reference.md route-guard table.
acceptance_criteria: 11-tutor-mode.md's banner reflects the grant-based redesign instead of asserting 'no new investment,' or the file moves to docs/_archive.
grep -r TutorPinGuard docs/ returns only files explicitly marked historical.
mergedFrom: Fix dead link to archived ux-design-specification.md in docs/planning/ux-patterns-quick-reference.md
